purpose: Actual stochastic Three.js SSRNode convergence against an independent converged SSR reference; not physically unbiased path tracing ground truth.
scene: Three adjacent metallic floor strips with roughness 0.12, 0.3 and 0.65; three emissive-color boxes; fixed perspective camera and static geometry.
dimensions: Four independently generated scalar volumes, seeds 1 through 4, used for Xi.x, Xi.y, ray-march jitter and Xi.w respectively. All values quantized to 8-bit bin centers. Same addressing and 32-frame cycle shift (37,71).

reference.generator: Three.js PCG integer hash with independent frame, pixel and dimension keys; no candidate masks

metrics: RGB RMSE of temporally averaged SSR output, all pixels and fixed lower-half floor ROI, raw and identical 3x3 binomial filtered candidate and reference. Report reference half-to-full RMSE separately.
limitations: Static scene only; no environment MIS, recurrent denoiser or production motion integration. Four seed dimensions form one evaluated sampler instance, not independent confidence trials.
